runs.text: Click anywhere in the table on the left.
Go to Insert > Maps > Filled Map.
Right-click on the chart, then Format Chart Area > Series to change the chart's properties.
Adjust the chart properties as needed

he chart will plot the first column to the right of the geography. In this example, it plots the column to the right of the country names. You can hide columns to keep them from plotting. In this example, we grouped columns C through E to hide them. If you click the ungroup button above the table you can see the chart change.
Go to Insert > Maps > Filled Map.
Right-click on the chart, then Format Chart Area > Series to change the chart's properties.
Click anywhere in the table on the left.
Adjust the chart properties as needed. This chart uses a diverging 3-color scale.

he chart will plot the first column to the right of the geography. In this case the Series column is being mapped, but if you click the group button above the table, you'll see the chart change to plot the % of World Population column.

sharedStrings: Quickly create powerful data visualizations from geographic data
